Definition: Ramoth-Negeb or Ramath-Negeb, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Ramoth-Negeb, or Ramath-Negeb, is a place in Palestine, a town in the south. David sent of the spoil to them in Ramoth, and to them in Jattir, and to them in Aroer, after he recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that the spoil list is a thank-you note: David remembered the towns that had stood with him in the south, and he sent them their share.
